value.title: Battle of Blenheim
value.snippet: The Battle of Blenheim (German: Zweite Schlacht bei Höchstädt; French: Bataille de Höchstädt; Dutch: Slag bij Blenheim) fought on 13 August [O.S. 2 August] 1704

value.title: Ferdinand de Marsin
value.snippet: after the battle of Speyerbach. In 1704 he was defeated at the Battle of Blenheim, together with Tallard, and was mortally wounded at the Battle of Turin

value.title: Huchtenburg
